Package org.apache.beam.sdk.io.gcp.testing

Class FakeDatasetService

java.lang.Object
org.apache.beam.sdk.io.gcp.testing.FakeDatasetService
All Implemented Interfaces:
Serializable, AutoCloseable, BigQueryServices.DatasetService, BigQueryServices.WriteStreamService
@Internal public class FakeDatasetService extends Object implements BigQueryServices.DatasetService, BigQueryServices.WriteStreamService, Serializable
A fake dataset service that can be serialized, for use in testReadFromTable.
